adapter.terms: Kogan.com Marketplace API v2 (AU/NZ). Product writes are asynchronous: the response carries status (AsyncResponsePending|Complete|CompleteWithErrors|Failed) and a pending_url to poll (GET /task/{task_id}/).

me.note: No account endpoint; the probe lists one of your products ({status, body: {next, previous, results[]}}) to verify SellerToken/SellerID.

update_listing.note: PATCH /products/ [{product_sku, product_title, product_description, stock}] updates only the keys sent ('only send the keys that have changed'); `listing_id` is your product SKU. The change is LIVE on kogan.com once processed. Asynchronous: status is AsyncResponsePending/Complete/CompleteWithErrors/Failed and raw.pending_url gives the result. `price` is NOT applied: prices live in offer_data keyed by store currency (AUD/NZD) and each entry also requires handling_days.

set_inventory.note: POST /products/stockprice/ [{product_sku, stock}] sets the stock of one product by SKU (`sku` is required; listing_id is not used). Stock 0 marks the listing sold out (removed automatically after 7 days). Asynchronous; see raw.pending_url.

end_listing.note: POST /products/status/ {product_sku, enabled: false} disables the product and removes the listing from the website immediately (reversible with enabled: true). `listing_id` is your product SKU. Kogan must grant this API to your account first (marketplace-support@kogan.com.au); otherwise 403.

list_orders.note: GET /orders/?status&startDateUTC&limit. `status` is REQUIRED by Kogan: ReleasedForShipment (paid, awaiting dispatch), Pending, AcknowledgedBySeller, PartiallyShipped, Shipped or Canceled; for Shipped/PartiallyShipped/Canceled the date range is at most 15 days. The endpoint has no offset/cursor, so there is no second page (raise `limit` instead). Items, addresses and dispatched items are in raw.

not_offered.create_listing: POST /products/ requires product_sku, title, description, brand, category, product_gtin, images, product_condition and per-currency offer_data {price, handling_days}; the vocabulary has no category, brand, GTIN or handling time.
not_offered.mark_shipped: POST /orders/fulfill/ takes dispatch lines per order ITEM: [{ID, Items: [{OrderItemID, SellerSku, Quantity, ShippedDateUtc, TrackingNumber, ShippingCarrier}]}]; item ids, SKUs and quantities are not vocabulary inputs.
